The dispute has not been identified, so retain a conspicuous placeholder rather than invent facts. Payment timing and enforcement language can be proposed subject to client approval.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We cannot accept the proposed USD 150,000 settlement amount; the amount remains open. Subject to our client’s approval and agreement on the complete terms, the enclosed revisions provide for payment within five business days, condition the release and any dismissal on receipt of full cleared funds, and add written notice, a two-business-day cure period, and recovery of reasonable enforcement costs and attorneys’ fees. The information provided does not identify the underlying dispute. We have retained an express placeholder for the specific dispute or action, which must be completed and confirmed before execution. No settlement is binding unless approved by the clients and executed by both parties.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising out of [IDENTIFY THE SPECIFIC DISPUTE, INCLUDING RELEVANT TRANSACTION OR EVENTS AND, IF FILED, ACTION CAPTION, COURT, AND CASE NUMBER] (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) in immediately available funds within five business days after this Agreement has been signed by both parties, using payment instructions separately provided and verified by Plaintiff. If Defendant fails to make payment when due, Plaintiff shall provide Defendant written notice of the payment default and two business days following Defendant’s receipt of that notice to cure the default. If the default remains uncured after that period, Plaintiff may enforce this Agreement and recover reasonable costs and attorneys’ fees incurred in such enforcement.

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from the claims arising out of the Dispute. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it. If an action concerning the Dispute is pending, Plaintiff shall file a dismissal with prejudice of the claims covered by this release within five business days after receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds. No such dismissal shall be filed or become effective before that receipt.

Please confirm whether your client will accept that amount or state its counterproposal, and supply the specific Dispute details for mutual confirmation; no agreement is binding absent client approval and execution by both parties.

This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; and disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations.
